subtitle: Lesson 23 · Delta Lake

code:
# Foundations Lesson 42: fewer files to read = less overhead.
#
# Every frequent write -- UPDATE, MERGE, streaming micro-batches --
# creates its OWN small set of files.
#
# Over time: thousands of tiny files. Genuinely slower to read.
caption: Even holding total data size constant.

code:
OPTIMIZE trips;

# Rewrites small files into fewer, larger ones.
# Same data, same schema -- itself just another Delta commit:
# new files ADD-ed, old small ones REMOVE-d.
caption: Lesson 17's mechanism again -- a performance cleanup, not a data change.

code:
OPTIMIZE trips ZORDER BY (VendorID);

# Co-locates rows sharing similar VendorID values.
# A later filter can skip whole files that provably
# don't match at all.
caption: Foundations Lesson 61's partition pruning idea, at the file-contents level.
